title: Warm Steamed Venezuelan Onion Empanadas
description: A pungent and crisp Venezuelan dish featuring onion, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this flexitarian-friendly empanada is steamed to perfection on a hot stone plate. The combination of sauteed onions and flaky pastry creates a delicious and satisfying meal.
instructions: Preheat a hot stone plate over medium heat.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions to the skillet and saute until they are softened and translucent.
Add the salt, black pepper, and garlic powder to the skillet and stir to combine.
Roll out the empanada pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Spoon the onion mixture onto one half of the pastry, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the onion mixture and press the edges to seal.
Place the empanadas on the preheated hot stone plate and pour the water over them.
Cover the plate with a lid or foil and steam the empanadas for 10 minutes.
Serve the empanadas warm, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
